title: Stability Transfer for Autonomous Systems via Higher-Order Taylor-Truncated Lyapunov Certificates
summary: We develop analytical sufficient conditions for certifying the local asymptotic stability of nonlinear autonomous systems based on Lyapunov functions derived from their finite-order Taylor polynomial approximations. This approach translates the stability analysis problem from the original nonlinear dynamics to a more computationally tractable polynomial domain. The derived conditions allow for the explicit calculation of a guaranteed inner approximation of the region of attraction ($\mathrm{ROA}$).
